pregame.pressurePoint: No unit has a clear edge. The closest thing to a swing: bengals run game vs dolphins run defense. The Bengals are No. 19 in rush success rate (38%) and No. 18 in EPA a carry (-0.09), and the Dolphins are No. 14 against the run (40%) and No. 6 by EPA a carry (-0.15). Strength on strength. Neither side has shown it can impose the run on a unit this good. The first stuffed series tells you who blinks. First quarter: who wins first contact.

edges.why: The Bengals are No. 4 of 32 against the run (33%) and No. 13 by EPA a carry (-0.10). The Dolphins rank No. 31 in rush success rate (32%) and No. 26 in EPA a carry (-0.14). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Bengals erase the run. The Dolphins get pushed into passing downs, and that is where this defense makes its money.

The Bengals are No. 4 of 32 on passing downs (30%). The Dolphins rank No. 12 in passing-downs success (41%). A real edge, not a lock. The Bengals get off the field on long downs. Early-down efficiency is everything for the Dolphins.
